advisories.reason: firebase pins @grpc/grpc-js ~1.9.0 through @firebase/firestore up to firebase 13.3.0, and 1.9 gets no fix. The flaw is in a gRPC server's getAuthContext with requireClientCertificate false; firestore runs grpc-js only as a client.

No fixed picomatch exists: the advisory covers every release up to the latest, 4.0.7. It arrives through fontaine > unplugin, which matches a build plugin's include and exclude globs with it. The build takes only fontaine's metric helpers (readMetrics, getMetricsForFamily, generateFontFace, resolveCategoryFallbacks) and never creates that plugin, so no glob from an app or a request reaches picomatch.
